architecture_contract.warning: The 85M label is a parameter-scale name, not a claim that 85 million cells were used for pretraining. The paper reports 82,402,543 parameters and 11.4 million training cells.

checkpoint_release_conflict.benchmark_action: Do not silently substitute the undocumented 20231027 VAE checkpoint for the documented 20230926 Gaussian-mixture checkpoint. Resolve the census entry before acquisition, or register both as separately named comparators after terms and hashes are available.
checkpoint_release_conflict.finding: The repository README calls 20230926_85M the latest version and the checked-in configuration uses the published Gaussian-mixture latent. The mutable Dropbox folder also contains an undocumented 20231027_85M pair whose configuration changes latent_mod from gmvae to vae. The released zero-shot embedding tutorial uses 20231027, while the cell-type annotation tutorial uses 20230926.

embedding_contract.common_lane_context: Each cell embedding is context-dependent. Construct deterministic row-ID-sorted context blocks within one biological donor and sample only; never pool cells across donors, outer folds, studies, or sealed and development sources.
embedding_contract.native_annotation_lane: The official annotation pipeline replaces the pretrained variational latent with a newly initialized 1024_to_512 linear latent and an annotation head, selects 3000 HVGs, and fine-tunes the embedder, encoder, latent, and head. Benchmark preprocessing, label encoding, and selection are reimplemented inside outer-training donors.
embedding_contract.released_20230926_zero_shot_embedding: 512d_GMVAE_posterior_mean_conditioned_on_a_sampled_hard_Gumbel_category; stochastic even in eval mode and therefore not the common representation
embedding_contract.released_20231027_zero_shot_embedding: 512d_plain_VAE_posterior_mean_in_eval_mode; this is a separately named native representation from the undocumented variant
upstream_paths_rejected_for_scoring: CellEmbeddingPipeline.score chooses the best Leiden resolution using the evaluation labels.
The tutorial combines train and test cells before HVG selection and model fitting.
CellTypeAnnotationPipeline.common_preprocess selects HVGs before applying the split field.

input_contract.normalization_warning: The paper declares library-size normalization plus log1p, but the released pipeline only applies log1p internally. Feeding raw counts directly does not reproduce the paper, while feeding already log-transformed values applies log1p twice.
input_contract.training_only_feature_selection: The common frozen-embedding lane uses all intersecting genes. The native annotation lane may use 3000 HVGs only when fitted on outer-training donors and then frozen.
input_contract.unmeasured_gene_rule: Use the released input_gene_list alignment for assayed genes and preserve an explicit assay-observability mask. Do not reinterpret an unmeasured gene as an observed biological zero.

runtime_contract.warning: The old Torch/CUDA/RAPIDS stack and Flowformer implementation require an isolated L40S import, forward/backward, checkpoint-load, resume, deterministic-context, and numeric-tolerance probe.

source_evidence: The ICLR 2024 proceedings paper, pinned official repository, checked-in configuration, tutorial code, and live Dropbox folder metadata were queried on 2026-08-22. Only the two small JSON configurations were retrieved; neither checkpoint weight was downloaded or deserialized.
